facts.fact: The Mauritius Digital Promotion Agency says the Minister of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation launched the inaugural Community Digital Empowerment Programme in Bel Air on 10-11 May 2025, with similar events planned in other regions.

Tech Review Africa reports Mauritius Telecom and AWS launched the free myt Learning Hub portal with 16 digital and AI courses for all Mauritians, as part of the government's target to train 50,000 people, with no number trained stated.

On 6 November 2026 Mauritius launched the myt Learning Hub Portal, built by Mauritius Telecom with AWS, offering 16 free courses in AI, cloud, cybersecurity and data in support of the government's goal of training 50,000 Mauritians in a year; no number trained is given.
